title: Direct-sum decompositions and projections
objectives: Prove the equivalent criteria for independent subspaces
Construct the projection on one summand along another
Characterize direct-sum decompositions by families of projections
Read the block-diagonal form from invariant summands
prerequisites: Bases, dimension, linear operators and invariant subspaces (Chapters 3, 4, 7 and 15).
source_scope: The captions of the two recordings (positions 34 and 35) were read in full. The plane projection example and the symmetric-matrix and eigenspace examples come from them; the running 3 by 3 operator, extra proofs, counterexamples, laboratory and exercises are original.
